verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a public REST API for creating workflows, managing event sources and handling subscriptions. It publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.4 spec, provides an interactive API playground, and ships TypeScript, Python and Java SDKs for the Connect API, so it clearly supports programmatic control. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API, and an API-wide versioning/deprecation policy (only an SDK-level commitment exists).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the REST API to create workflows, manage event sources, handle subscriptions, and more.
Pipedream publishes its REST API as a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.4 document
Pipedream provides TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs along with a REST API to interact with the Connect service.
You can also consume events emitted by sources using Pipedream's REST API or a private, real-time SSE stream.
